run_pretrain_croco: run the CroCo pre-training script with default habitat_release dataset and 400 max epochs
run_pretrain_custom_dataset: run CroCo pre-training on a custom dataset with specified transforms and batch size
run_pretrain_distributed: run distributed CroCo pre-training across multiple GPUs with gradient accumulation enabled
run_pretrain_resume: resume CroCo pre-training from the last saved checkpoint in the output directory
run_pretrain_amp: run CroCo pre-training with automatic mixed precision enabled for faster training
